name: Muesli Fruit, Nut & Seeds
ingredients_raw: MULTIGRAIN MIX (66%) {CORN GRITS (18.3%), WHEAT (16.5%), RICE (9.7%), ROLLED BARLEY (8%), ROLLED OATS (8%), RAGI MILLET FLOUR (3.5%), RICE FLOUR, CORN MEAL, REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA)}, CANDIED FRUITS, DRY FRUITS, NUT & SEED (21%) {CANDIED PAPAYA (5%), ALMONDS (3.5%), PUMPKIN SEEDS (3.5%), CANDIED CRANBERRY (3%), BLACK CURRANTS (3%), BLACK RAISINS (3%)}, SUGAR, CEREAL EXTRACT, WHEAT BRAN, HONEY, OLIGOFRUCTOSE, IODIZED SALT, COCOA SOLIDS VITAMINS, COLOURS (INS 140, INS 150d), FLAVOURS {NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL (COCONUT)}, ANTIOXIDANT (INS 307b) AND MINERAL. ALLGEN DECLARATION: CONTAINS WHEAT, BARLEY, OATS, NUT (ALMONDS), SULPHITE MAY CONTAIN OTHER NUTS, SOY AND MILK. SOME CANDIED AND DRY FRUITS CONTAIN SULPHITE TO MAINTAIN COLOUR
